title: 第29章 赤焰粉
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
天黑，收工。

    陈青山把三袋灰拖到外炉登记处，过秤。

    管秤的老杂役眼皮都懒得抬，铜秤砣往秤杆上一挂，看也不看就报数：“足。画押。”

    陈青山按了手印。

    三袋灰，足斤足两，成色不掺一点假。账面上交得干干净净，谁来翻都挑不出毛病。

    他动的，从来不是这三袋。

    脚边那一小堆扫地碎渣，趁老杂役低头记册的工夫，他拿块破布一兜，往腰后一塞。

    满身满脸都是灰，没人会去盯一个穷杂役裤腿上那点扫不净的废末。

    出了火脉洞，山风一灌，后背的汗瞬间凉透。

    他弓着腰咳了两声，把肺里那股焦辣咳出来一半。剩下一半，像扎了根，怎么也清不掉。

    这才头一天，嗓子就废了半条。

    可他脚步不慢。

    腰后那点东西，从早上铲出来那一下起，就把识海里的造化鼎闹得一刻不停。它馋。它从没这么馋过。

    回到丁七号，关门，落栓，破布堵窗缝。

    老一套了。

    外人听见屋里有动静，只会当他这穷鬼又在折腾废料。

    烟味焦味往外飘，正好盖住别的味道。这是他这半年练出来的本事——做贼，先得让人看不出你在做贼。

    油灯点上。

    他把那兜碎渣倒进豁口陶盆。

    灰是死黑的，混着碎石、铁屑、扫起来的杂末，看着跟外头随便哪个炉子的灰没两样。

    可中间那几粒暗金，在灯下闷闷地泛着光，不扎眼，却沉得很。

    就是它。

    陈青山没急着上手。

    是肥是坑，回屋慢慢验——这话他在火脉洞咽了整整一天。现在，门关了，灯亮了，终于能验了。

    心念一沉，那口鼎转了过来。

    灰，入鼎。

    鼎口一张，整盆灰被卷了进去。

    鼎火不烈，慢悠悠地舔，像一条舌头，把死灰里的东西一层层剥开——碎石化渣，铁屑沉底，杂末成烟。

    最后剩下中间那一撮，越缩越小，越缩越红。

    红得像一捧没烧透的火星子。

    陈青山屏着气，眼睛一眨不眨。

    一盆灰，足有十斤。鼎火转了小半个时辰，最后吐出来的，薄薄一层。

    他抓起炭笔，在墙根划下一道。

    十斤灰，出三钱粉。

    这粉，他认得那股味。火脉洞里呛得人睁不开眼的焦辣，全凝在这三钱里头了。比库房那点火精铁还冲，还纯。
content_en:
It's dark, call it a day.

    Chen Qingshan dragged the three bags of ash to the outer furnace registration office and weighed them.

    The old handyman in charge of the scale didn't bother to lift his eyes. He hung the copper scale weight on the scale beam and reported the number without looking at it: "Enough. Draw a mark."

    Chen Qingshan pressed his fingerprints.

    Three bags of ash weigh a full pound, and the quality is not adulterated at all. The accounts are so clean that no one who looks through them can find anything wrong.

    It was never these three bags that he moved.

    There was a small pile of sweeping scraps at his feet. While the old handyman was lowering his head to write down the books, he took a pocket of rags and stuffed them behind his waist.

    With his body and face covered in ashes, no one would look at the unswept spots on a poor handyman's trousers.

    After leaving the Fire Vein Cave, the mountain breeze hit me, and the sweat on my back instantly cooled down.

    He arched his back and coughed twice, coughing up half of the burning sensation in his lungs. The remaining half seems to have taken root and cannot be removed no matter what.

    It was only the first day, and half of my voice was gone.

    But his steps are not slow.

    That little thing on the back of the waist has been making the Cauldron of Creation in the sea of ​​consciousness non-stop since the moment it was shoveled out in the morning. It's greedy. It has never been so greedy.

    Back at No. 7 Ding, I closed the door, lowered the bolt, and blocked the cracks in the window with rags.

    Same old thing.

    If outsiders heard any movement in the house, they would just think that he was a poor man messing with scraps again.

    The burnt smell of smoke wafts out, just covering up other smells. This is a skill he has developed over the past six months - to be a thief, you must first make it difficult for people to see that you are a thief.

    Light the oil lamp.

    He poured the bag of crumbs into the cracked pottery basin.

    The ashes were extremely black, mixed with gravel, iron filings, and other debris that had been swept up. It looked just like the ashes from any stove outside.

    But the few grains of dark gold in the middle glowed dullly under the lamp, not eye-catching, but very heavy.

    That's it.

    Chen Qingshan was in no hurry to get started.

    Whether it's fat or a pit, go back to the house and check it slowly - he swallowed these words for a whole day in the Fire Vein Cave. Now, with the door closed and the lights on, I can finally test it.

    With a thought, the cauldron turned around.

    Gray, enter the cauldron.

    When the tripod opened its mouth, the entire basin of ashes was swept in.

    The fire of the cauldron is not strong, and it is licked slowly, like a tongue, peeling off the things in the ashes layer by layer - the gravel turns into slag, the iron filings sink to the bottom, and the debris turns into smoke.

    Finally, the bunch in the middle is left, getting smaller and smaller, and the more it shrinks, the redder it becomes.

    As red as a handful of unburnt sparks.

    Chen Qingshan held his breath and kept his eyes unblinking.

    A basin of ashes weighs ten kilograms. The cauldron fire turned for half an hour, and the last thing spit out was a thin layer.

    He grabbed a charcoal pencil and drew a line at the base of the wall.

    Ten pounds of ash, three coins of powder.

    He recognized the smell of this powder. The burning heat in the Fire Vein Cave, which made people unable to open their eyes, was all concentrated in these three coins. It's more powerful and pure than the ignition iron in the warehouse.
